object_description: elongated single-story building with a broad canopy
design_condition: Placed along Welschmattstrasse, the low building remains subordinate to the existing school, preserves spatial connections through the site, and frames a connected longitudinal outdoor space, but its large footprint reduces tree retention.

positive.statement: The child-friendly scale makes the building subordinate to the existing school building as a serving element.
The tree-lined, connected and longitudinal outdoor space is given great importance.
The precise positioning and contemporary independent expression fit the existing context.
The visually covered outdoor area ties the school rooms together.
The structural lighting on both sides provides daylight to the school rooms.
The internal division is detached from the basic structure and is flexible.
The project has a comparatively small volume and little floor space and can therefore be classified as economical.
The investment costs are favorable compared to the other award-winning projects.

negative.statement: The large footprint cannot comply with the tree protection requirements, retaining only a third of the meadow areas.
The building structure is not optimally integrated into the precise path network.
The organization and development of the additive spatial structure are not optimally solved.
The adjoining uses are not optimally developed or sufficiently separated, and the individual entrances are too small.
The static construction is likely to be cost-intensive.
The building is not very compact due to its single-story structure and dimensions.
It is questionable whether the proposed materialization could achieve Minergie-P-ECO.
